title: 주름진 손
suno_analysis_sp: K-Pop ballad featuring a male baritone vocal. The arrangement centers on a solo violin playing a lyrical melody over a grand piano. The piano performs arpeggiated chords in the lower register and syncopated block chords in the mid-range. A legato string section provides harmonic padding. The tempo is 72 BPM in 4/4 time. The vocal performance is intimate with breathy delivery in the lower register, transitioning to a resonant chest voice. The production features long-tail plate reverb on the violin and vocals.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
[Intro]
[solo violin melody, arpeggiated grand piano]

[Verse 1]
[male baritone vocals, breathy delivery]
손가락 하나 잡아도 [legato strings enter]
시간이 스민다
오십 년을 함께 걸어온
두 손이 만날 때
주름살 사이로 담긴 것은 말하지 않아도 통하는가
봄날부터 겨울까지
우리는 손을 놓지 않았고
지금 이 순간에도 당신의
온기가 진짜다
